fields.name: borderRadius
fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Default is 2em (Joubel UI). Lower values are sharper; higher values are more rounded.

fields.name: autoContinue
fields.label: Auto continue
fields.description: Automatically go to next question when alternative is selected. This needs to be turned off to make the content fully accessible when using a screen reader.

fields.name: timeoutCorrect
fields.label: Timeout on correct answers
fields.description: Value in milliseconds

fields.name: timeoutWrong
fields.label: Timeout on wrong answers
fields.description: Value in milliseconds

fields.name: enableSolutionsButton
fields.label: Show correct answer when wrong
fields.description: When enabled, the correct alternative is revealed after an incorrect response. When disabled, only whether the answer was right or wrong is shown.

fields.name: enableShowSolutionButton
fields.label: Enable show solution button
fields.description: When enabled, a button on the results slide opens a list of all questions with their correct answers.

fields.name: passPercentage

fields.name: a11yShowSolution
fields.label: Assistive technology description for "Show Solution" button
fields.default: Show the solution. The task will be marked with its correct solution.

fields.name: a11yRetry
fields.label: Assistive technology description for "Retry" button
fields.default: Retry the task. Reset all responses and start the task over again.
